newsitem.title: CROATIA: Croatia sells 42-day T-bills at flat 9.0 pct rate.
newsitem.headline: Croatia sells 42-day T-bills at flat 9.0 pct rate.

text.p: Croatia's Finance Ministry said on Tuesday it raised 109.4 million kuna through a new 42-day treasury-bill issue at an unchanged rate of 9.0 percent.
The issued amount fell short of its 150 million kuna target after it rejected some of the 139.4 million total bids.
Bills are payable in two days and mature on October 2.
Clients can view full results on page MFHT.
Banking sector bought some 90.5 percent of the issue. Auctions are not open to foreign investors though they can place their bids through Croatian banks.
The ministry said it had 484.5 million kuna in outstanding 42-, 91- and 182-day T-bills.
It set the next auction for August 26, when it will offer investors 60 million kuna worth of 91-day bills. -- Kolumbina Bencevic, Zagreb newsroom +385 1 455 7075
